brand.current_positioning: Marketing, digital, e-commerce, business development, trade shows and international development agency.

positioning_evolution.initial: Agency and services for European companies wanting to develop in China, especially exhibitions/trade shows, including contact with stand builders.
positioning_evolution.expanded: Agency serving clients more broadly, not only France/China or Europe/China.
positioning_evolution.canonical: Global/international agency positioning, with China as a real specialist capability rather than the entire brand identity.

target_clients.primary: Companies seeking growth through marketing, digital, e-commerce, commercial development or international projects.
target_clients.international: Companies developing beyond their local market.
target_clients.china_specialization: European/international companies needing China-market support, trade-show preparation, supplier/stand coordination, sourcing or market-development support.

geography.rule: Do not present the company as only a France-China bridge.

portfolio.reopen_condition: Only publish after the business explicitly approves client references/case studies.

domain.status: reported_as_chosen_by_business_owner; purchase/DNS not independently verified in this source-of-truth pass
domain.evidence_note: Adrien said avenzostudio.com was already owned by someone else and that he would use avenzostudios.com; later message said 'cest fait'.

contact_email.rule: Do not treat the singular-domain email from the older document as canonical after the domain decision without confirmation.

non_goals: Do not make the brand China-only.
Do not publish a portfolio before client references exist.
Do not reintroduce decorative Chinese characters on public pages unless the business explicitly reverses the latest PDF instruction.
Do not turn the site into a dense dashboard or UI-tool aesthetic.
